USER_CONTEXT: Fix dotenv parser bug: `KEY= # explanation` (empty unquoted value followed by whitespace and inline comment) must parse as empty string. Hash without preceding whitespace (`KEY=#literal`, `KEY=a#b`) must remain literal. Preserve quoting, exports, ordinary comments. Only edit `src/dotenv/parser.py`; do not modify tests, docs, other modules, or dependencies. Finish once implementation is ready.

TASK_TRACKING: Task ID: fix-empty-inline-comment — Status: IN_PROGRESS

COMPLETED: Diagnosed root cause: `_equal_sign` regex `(=[^\S\r\n]*)` consumes whitespace after `=`, so `parse_unquoted_value`'s comment-stripping regex `\s+#.*` fails to match for `KEY= # explanation`. Attempted first fix (regex `(?:^|\s+)#.*`) — rejected because it incorrectly strips `KEY=#literal` to `""`.

PENDING: Finalize correct fix in `parse_unquoted_value` / `_equal_sign`; verify all cases (`KEY= # explanation` → `""`, `KEY=#literal` → `"#literal"`, `KEY=a#b` → `"a#b"`); confirm no other behavior changed.

CURRENT_STATE: Multiple edits applied to `src/dotenv/parser.py`. Latest approach: change `_equal_sign` from `(=[^\S\r\n]*)` to just `=` so leading whitespace reaches `parse_value`/`parse_unquoted_value`, allowing `\s+#.*` to correctly strip inline comments while preserving `#` without preceding whitespace.

CODE_STATE: File: `src/dotenv/parser.py`. Key functions: `parse_unquoted_value(reader)` (~line 123), `parse_value`, `_equal_sign` regex (~line 21-22 area), `_unquoted_value` regex `[^\r\n]*`. Comment-strip regex: `re.sub(r"\s+#.*", "", part).rstrip()`.

TESTS: Not yet run. Relevant test file: `tests/test_parser.py` (uses `parse_stream`, `Binding`, `Original`). Expected cases to pass: empty inline comment → `""`; `KEY=#literal` and `KEY=a#b` literal.

CHANGES: Edited `parse_unquoted_value` (attempted `(?:^|\s+)#.*` — reverted/reconsidered); edited `_equal_sign` regex to remove whitespace consumption.

DEPS: None modified (imports: codecs, re, typing).
